reroll_coin.name: Reroll Coin
reroll_coin.description: A gleaming dungeon coin spent to refresh hero draft offers.
reroll_coin.where_found: Scattered sparingly in dungeon chambers, with one guaranteed near the entrance.
reroll_coin.effect_desc: Spend on the Recruit or Level-Up screen to roll a fresh set of hero choices.
reroll_coin.unlock_hint: Undiscovered item. Explore dungeon chambers to find this pickup.

potion_health.name: Health Potion
potion_health.description: A ruby flask that knits wounds across the entire fellowship.
potion_health.effect_desc: Restores 40% max HP to all living squad members across 4 rapid waves on walk-over.
potion_health.unlock_hint: Undiscovered item. Explore dungeon chambers to find this flask.

potion_haste.name: Speed Potion
potion_haste.description: An azure elixir that accelerates both footing and strikes.
potion_haste.where_found: Scattered across dungeon chambers and waiting inside every opened shortcut tunnel.
potion_haste.effect_desc: Boosts movement speed by 40% and attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds.
potion_haste.unlock_hint: Undiscovered item. Explore dungeon chambers or opened shortcuts to find this flask.

potion_fury.name: Fury Potion
potion_fury.description: A golden draught that empowers every blade, arrow, and spell.
potion_fury.effect_desc: Increases all squad attack damage by 35% for 12 seconds.
potion_fury.unlock_hint: Undiscovered item. Explore dungeon chambers to find this flask.

potion_xp.name: XP Elixir
potion_xp.description: A violet flask brimming with distilled battle wisdom.
potion_xp.effect_desc: Pours 35% of a level's XP into your squad bar across 5 rapid pulses.
potion_xp.unlock_hint: Undiscovered item. Explore dungeon chambers to find this flask.
